WALLET FORK CLOSED — SENTINEL IS NEVER GIVEN OUT, ALWAYS OURS
They host the compute, we keep the meter. They resell our credit unit for our service at their own rate. No forked ledger, no per-tenant Sentinel, no wallet in the takeout. Recorded on BEB-6800.

6804 CONSEQUENCE — a moved instance still calls Sentinel over the network
That call path surviving the move is an ACCEPTANCE item, not an assumption. Sentinel unreachable degrades by name, RATE UNAVAILABLE, settlement disabled — never a local fallback ledger.

NO PII ON CREDIT USE — ledger rows carry a KEY, never a person
Key, worker, reason, activity, markup, amount, timestamp, period. No name, email, IP, UA, or prompt text. CRM holds the person, ledger holds the key, they join at read time under auth. Never a copy.

RULING ON RECORD, NOT SPECCED — no PII on credit use
Alex 2026-08-28, deferred by him. Recorded on BEB-3895. Nobody designs against it yet; it pulls against 3898 live usage and the coop attribution requirement, and that tension is his to settle later.

BEB-6805 WORTH A VIDEO — the managers RANK, not just emit
Every landing scored from rows: fires retired, blast radius, age of the fault, claim overturned, visible to a person. Human line written at land time with a real number in it. Today's session is the test set.
